About.title: Reliable car rental in the heart of Herzegovina
About.lead: MAXIMUM RENT A CAR d.o.o. was founded in April 2009. With professional service and a reliable fleet that keeps growing, we have built a name people recognise. Our motto is the satisfaction of every client, and that is what drives us to keep improving.
About.intro2: We are based in Međugorje, the largest religious and tourist centre not only in Bosnia and Herzegovina but in this part of Europe. Besides Međugorje, vehicles can also be collected in Mostar, at Mostar Airport, and in Čitluk, Ljubuški and Čapljina.
About.storyP1: MAXIMUM RENT A CAR d.o.o. stands out for an excellent fleet and friendly staff, always ready to help with any request. We work 365 days a year and are available even outside business hours.
About.storyP2: Whether you come to Međugorje as a tourist or on business, we are at your service. You will find the rental terms and other information on our website, and you can reach us through the form, by phone or on WhatsApp.

Business.title: Long term car rental for your business
Business.lead: Professional fleet management without burdening your balance sheet. Flexible, simple and with a predictable monthly cost.
Business.flexP1: Long term rental is designed for companies and individuals who want a professional service that makes running a fleet easier. The flexibility of our long term rental is a must for most modern companies.
Business.flexP2: The biggest advantage of long term rental is that we take on all the financial risks that leasing puts on your company. Your balance sheet stays clear, you pay only for the days you use the vehicle, you keep control of costs, and returning the vehicle early brings no extra charges.
Business.simpleP1: If your business is seasonal, long term rental lets you match costs to the periods you plan for. Unlike leasing, you need no extra capital or financing approval, and if you need more or fewer vehicles, we arrange it at very short notice.
Business.simpleP2: Long term rental keeps monthly costs low and predictable, based on the rental length in months and the agreed mileage.

Terms.title: Rental terms
Terms.lead: Clear terms for a carefree rental.
items: The minimum driver age is 21, with a driving licence held for more than 2 years.
A valid ID card or passport and a driving licence are needed to collect the vehicle.
The rental price includes basic insurance, BiH vignettes and unlimited mileage.
The deposit depends on the vehicle class and is fully refunded after a proper return.
The vehicle is collected and returned with a full fuel tank.
Taking the vehicle outside BiH is possible with prior notice and the right paperwork.
Free cancellation is possible up to 48 hours before pickup.
